step1_analysis.description: A passive low-pass filter network (pi-network equivalent) used to model a photodiode capacitance and an interstage matching network for bandwidth enhancement in a transimpedance amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: 20 * log10(R2). For R2=500 ohms, Gain = 54 dB ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined entirely by the load resistor R2 in this passive model.

bandwidth_3dB.description: Frequency at which the transimpedance gain drops by 3 dB from its low-frequency value

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on L2, C3, and CPD. With inductive peaking, BW > 1/(2*pi*R2*CPD).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper achieves 9.2 GHz using bandwidth enhancement techniques. The passive network can be tuned to this value.

gain_peaking.description: Maximum gain peaking above the low-frequency gain

sky130_expected.reasoning: A well-designed Butterworth-like response will have 0 dB peaking, while Chebyshev-like might have up to 3 dB.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure transimpedance gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and gain peaking of the passive matching network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Passive Matching Network

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param C_pd=0.5p
.param L_2=10n
.param C_3=0.1p
.param R_2=500

* Dummy VDD to satisfy requirements
Vdd VDD GND 1.8

* DUT
IIn N1 GND AC 1
CPD N1 GND {C_pd}
L2 N1 N2 {L_2}
C3 N2 GND {C_3}
R2 N2 GND {R_2}

.control
ac dec 100 1M 100G

* Transimpedance gain in dB ohms
let tz_db = vdb(N2)

* Measure low frequency gain (at 1 MHz)
meas ac tz_dc find tz_db at=1M

* Measure maximum gain for peaking
meas ac tz_max max tz_db
let peaking = tz_max - tz_dc
print peaking

* Measure 3-dB bandwidth
let tz_3db = tz_dc - 3
meas ac bw_3db when tz_db=tz_3db fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
